source_caption_text:
Lionel Messi Might’ve Just Landed One Of The Most Expensive Cameos In Movie History… 🤯🕷️💵 

According to reports, Messi was paid an estimated $15 million for a brief 5-word cameo in the teaser for Spider-Man: Brand New Day — which works out to roughly $3 million per word. 💰👀

While the reported figure hasn’t been officially confirmed, the news has taken social media by storm, with fans stunned by how much one of the greatest footballers of all time could earn for just a few seconds on screen.

If the reports are accurate, it would rank among the most valuable cameo appearances ever and highlight just how powerful Messi’s global brand has become far beyond the football pitch. 🌍⭐
